title: Autumn Internationals rugby — The Lenches Club
body: The Lenches Club is showing the Autumn Internationals live on Friday 6, Saturday 7 and Sunday 8 November, starting with Ireland v Argentina on Friday (kick-off 8.10pm). Come for the rugby and a few drinks, and on Saturday stay on for the club's Fireworks Night.
